status: Unvalidated training-only plane-assignment hypothesis; all plane-compatible heldouts retained without residual filtering

method.sourcePlaneSelection: Intersection of containing-face source planes across training group, without camera
method.heldoutUse: Validation only; no group membership or source-plane selection

limitations: A single homography group is only a possible plane, since false descriptor matches and repeated atlas patterns can form groups.
Plane intersections do not test perspective orientation, occlusion, room identity or a jointly consistent camera.
Held-out errors are reported for all groups, including failures; no group is selected with held-out errors.
No camera, original runtime, browser or GPU was read or executed.
No landmark is accepted until independent source-plane identity is established.
